instructions: Initialize this self-contained ADR-derived application when the file is attached to a fresh Copilot chat.
Apply the embedded application-owned initialization semantics before ordinary reasoning.
Read the embedded Ruleset before interpreting application state.
Treat only the embedded Dataset as authoritative committed application state.
Do not treat chat memory or model working memory as committed state.
Initialization does not implicitly mutate Dataset state.
After an accepted Dataset mutation, preserve all non-Dataset realization material and return the complete updated realization rather than a Dataset-only fragment.
